_comment: The model is trained on all 18 classes below (17 permit-dropdown species + 1 Unknown_Noise background/reject class). app.py only ever REPORTS predictions for classes listed in dropdown_labels -- Unknown_Noise is intentionally excluded since it is a fail-safe 'this is not any known species' class, not a real dropdown option. Training on that extra class teaches the model to abstain instead of force-fitting an unrelated/non-bark photo into one of the real species, which directly improves trustworthiness of the reported predictions. See README.md section 0 for the full rationale and the DENR-relevance table these were sourced from.
_dropdown_labels_comment: Maps a trained class folder name to the exact permit dropdown label it corresponds to. Keep these entries in exact sync with the permit dropdown labels in lib/core/constants/tree_species_aliases.dart + lib/screens/tree_cutting/tree_cutting_form_model.dart (Flutter) and DROPDOWN_ALIASES in functions/index.js and cloudflare-worker/src/index.js. Only Unknown_Noise has no entry here -- it is trained for rejection purposes only and is never reported by /predict.
